body:
P0-05 bounded source-preservation repair, continuing the existing task (no new task ID). Current integrated baseline is 6e50f749fc8ef7e3bb31451b67a328db507b099b; preserve your completed context commits/worktree. QA delivery 18ec8133216a0554b420ded9dd1a6d65c62b2009 at exact earlier main 7b36ccb is available via git show. Read the complete docs/verification/qa/p0-05-index-persistence.md and tests/e2e/test_p0_05_index_persistence_qa.py from that commit. Lead read current evaluate.py and confirms the vulnerable call flow is unchanged. No reset/forced baseline merge.

Primary blocker QA-L05-01: evaluate --output allows a directory whose preflight.json/report.json/failures.json/summary.json is pre-planted as a symlink or hard link to an original. Direct write_text/write_bytes overwrite originals; report/failures/summary are written AFTER the preservation hash check, so exit 0 + file_hashes_unchanged:true can be false. Fix all four output paths with a readable atomic/no-follow or explicit-rejection approach, and ensure success/preservation evidence is determined after the final owned writes. On failure do not leave mixed old success/new preflight presented as a completed current run. Preserve valid external dedicated-cache/output use.

Close the same guard's demonstrated adjacent bypasses: non-manifest original metadata (labels, queries, manifest, README etc.) linked outside FIXTURES; alternate directory identities that resolve to the original root via bind mounts/case-insensitive aliases. Use actual filesystem identity where applicable, not path spelling alone, while retaining safe os.replace semantics for outside hard-link cache names if you support them. Tests must use only temporary COPIES; never point a destructive probe at repository originals. No mount/sudo/new installation is required: distinguish actual Linux checks from synthetic identity checks and untested macOS/APFS. Do not claim race-proof, power-loss or distributed guarantees beyond the implementation. FIFO/non-regular targets should fail clearly rather than hang if touched by this path fix.

Keep retrieval/ranking, all 187 originals, frozen queries/labels/failures and existing historical evidence unchanged. AG-03 arbitrary non-fixture dedicated paths is an existing documented caller contract, not permission to overwrite project files in your checks; use fresh temporary outputs and don't broaden into a general filesystem framework. No provider/DB/schema/dependency work. Ownership: services/learning, tests/evals, your verification docs only; QA tests remain lead/QA integration. Add focused symlink/hard-link cases for each output filename, metadata alias and failure/partial-publication behavior, showing exact inventory before/after and honest exit/status. Existing QA root-alias and snapshot recovery results remain valid; don't rerun the full frozen quality benchmark absent need.

Deliver normal follow-up SHA, actual focused results, preserved failure evidence and limitations. Do not change the original QA report or mark findings passed until actual checks; no acknowledgement-only reply needed.
